title: Alien
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#6ee86e' stroke='#a8ffa8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#54cc54' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- eyes (big alien eyes) -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='36' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='36' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='32' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='32' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='38' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#66b3ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='38' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#66b3ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 50 Q50 58 60 50' fill='none' stroke='#2d8a2d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae stalks -->
  <line x1='38' y1='17' x2='32' y2='6' stroke='#6ee86e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='17' x2='68' y2='6' stroke='#6ee86e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna balls -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='5' r='4' fill='#ff6ec7' stroke='#ffb3e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='5' r='4' fill='#ff6ec7' stroke='#ffb3e0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#6ee86e'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='20' ry='12' fill='#54cc54' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#b3ffb3'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <line x1='30' y1='72' x2='14' y2='64' stroke='#6ee86e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='72' x2='86' y2='64' stroke='#6ee86e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='13' cy='63' r='4.5' fill='#6ee86e' stroke='#a8ffa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='63' r='4.5' fill='#6ee86e' stroke='#a8ffa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3da03d'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3da03d'/>
</svg>
